verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an official MCP integration for the Rive Editor whose tools write content: they create View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states, Layouts and Shapes. Rive Markup Language (RML) also lets coding agents create and modify Rive files as code, and the homepage says an agent can generate experiences via a CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP and RML write paths work, depth beyond the self-described 'first set' of MCP tools, documentation of the agent CLI, and a public write API (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
